about: The Haftarah from the Prophets (Zechariah 2:10–4:7) is read for Chanukah. The prophet sees the high priest cleansed, the Branch promised, and a golden menorah fed with oil, with the word “Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit.” The reading from the Apostles (John 10:22–38) takes place at the Feast of Dedication (Chanukah) in the Temple courts. There Yeshua declares that he and the Father are one, and calls himself the one “whom the Father consecrated and sent into the world.”
